title: A worker's brief tells it to commit by turn 1 when dispatch's cap is not above the commit margin
goal: worker_rules in bl_dispatch.py clamps the commit-by turn to max(cap - COMMIT_MARGIN, 1), so dispatch --max-turns 10 writes 'by turn 1 commit what you have' into the brief; a cap at or below the margin gets a commit-by turn that leaves the worker room to work, or dispatch refuses such a cap. Found by the SP-mujl7ebh review.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_dispatch as d;r=' '.join(x for x in d.worker_rules('.','X','work/X',10) if 'turn cap' in x);sys.exit(1 if 'by turn 1 ' in r else 0)
